verses.transliteration: taṁ dṛṣṭvā patitaṁ bhūmau khaḍgamutpalasannibham।muṣṭiṁ saṁvartayāmāsa vajrakalpaṁ mahābalaḥ ।। 6.76.24 ।।

translations.english: Seeing the pestle shaped sword fallen on the ground, mighty Prajaghna clenched his fist, which was as hard as the thunderbolt.
translations.hindi: सुन्दर नेत्रों से युक्त इसका का दो कुण्डलो से भूषित झे ऐसा जान पड़ता है, जैसा कि, पुन्वंसु नक्षत्र के बीच में पूर्ण बिम्क्‍्ताला चन्द्रमा

verses.sloka: ललाटे स महावीर्यमङ्गदं वानरर्षभम्।आजघान महातेजाः स मुहूर्तं चचाल ह ।। ६.७६.२५ ।।
verses.transliteration: lalāṭe sa mahāvīryamaṅgadaṁ vānararṣabham।ājaghāna mahātejāḥ sa muhūrtaṁ cacāla ha ।। 6.76.25 ।।

translations.english: Sonitaksha of extraordinary energy hit at the forehead of highly valiant Angada. For a while Angada was unable to move.

verses.sloka: स सञ्ज्ञां प्राप्य तेजस्वी वालिपुत्रः प्रतापवान्।प्रजङ्घस्य शिरः कायात् खड्गेनापातयत् क्षितौ ।। ६.७६.२६ ।।
verses.transliteration: sa sañjñāṁ prāpya tejasvī vāliputraḥ pratāpavān।prajaṅghasya śiraḥ kāyāt khaḍgenāpātayat kṣitau ।। 6.76.26 ।।

translations.english: Son of Vali, who was full of vigour, on regaining consciousness hit Prajaghna on the head and trunk and made him fall down.
translations.hindi: अद्रित तेज सम्पन्न राजकुमार श्रोरामचन्द्र जी ने जब इस प्रकार पछा ; तब महातेजस्वी विभीषण नें श्रोरामचन्ड्र जी काँ उत्तर ऐेते हुए उनसे कहा

verses.sloka: स यूपाक्षो ऽश्रुपूर्णाक्षः पितृव्ये निहते रणे।अवरुह्य रथात् क्षिप्रं क्षीणेषुः खड्गमाददे ।। ६.७६.२७ ।।
verses.transliteration: sa yūpākṣo 'śrupūrṇākṣaḥ pitṛvye nihate raṇe।avaruhya rathāt kṣipraṁ kṣīṇeṣuḥ khaḍgamādade ।। 6.76.27 ।।

translations.english: Instantly alighting from the chariot, Yupaksha seeing the uncle exhausted and hurt, eyes filled with tears, he wielded the sword.
translations.hindi: दस सिर बाला , महातेजस्वी, राजा कुवेर का छोडा भाई; भयङ्कर फ़त्य करने नाला बड़ा उत्साही और महाबली जो शक्षस- राज सवण है,

verses.sloka: तमापतन्तं सम्प्रेक्ष्य यूपाक्षं द्विविदस्त्वरन्।आजघानोरसि क्रुद्धो जाग्राह च बलाद्बली ।। ६.७६.२८ ।।
verses.transliteration: tamāpatantaṁ samprekṣya yūpākṣaṁ dvividastvaran।ājaghānorasi kruddho jāgrāha ca balādbalī ।। 6.76.28 ।।

translations.english: Observing Yupakasha fallen and rushing quickly, furious Dwivida struck him in the bosom with force and caught him
translations.hindi: उसका यह पराक्रमी पुत्र है ओर रावण हो को तर करने में निपुण है । यढ वृद्धा की सेवा करने बाला हे आर सब शब्यधारियों में अग्रणी हे

verses.sloka: गृहीतं भ्रातरं दृष्ट्वा शोणिताक्षो महाबलः।आजघान गदाग्रेण वक्षसि द्विविदं ततः ।। ६.७६.२९ ।।
verses.transliteration: gṛhītaṁ bhrātaraṁ dṛṣṭvā śoṇitākṣo mahābalaḥ।ājaghāna gadāgreṇa vakṣasi dvividaṁ tataḥ ।। 6.76.29 ।।

translations.english: Then seeing the brother caught, mighty Sonitaksha struck Dwivida in the bosom by a mace.

verses.sloka: स गदाभिहतस्तेन चचाल च महाबलः।उद्यतां च पुनस्तस्य जहार द्विविदो गदाम् ।। ६.७६.३० ।।
verses.transliteration: sa gadābhihatastena cacāla ca mahābalaḥ।udyatāṁ ca punastasya jahāra dvivido gadām ।। 6.76.30 ।।

translations.english: Dwivida, though mighty reeled and could not move when struck by Sonitaksha. He got up and again and snatched the mace from Sonithaksha.
translations.hindi: । युद्ध भ्त है ४१७ , जै १२ युद्धकाण्डे यस्य बाहू समाश्रित्य लङ्का वसति निभया । तनयं धान्यमालिन्या अतिकायमिमं विदुः

verses.sloka: एतस्मिन्नन्तरे वीरो मैन्दो वानरयूथपः।यूपाक्षं ताडयामास तलेनोरसि वीर्यवान् ।। ६.७६.३१ ।।
verses.transliteration: etasminnantare vīro maindo vānarayūthapaḥ।yūpākṣaṁ tāḍayāmāsa talenorasi vīryavān ।। 6.76.31 ।।

translations.english: In the meantime, valiant Vanara leader Mainda arrived and struck with his palm on the chest of Yupaksha.
translations.hindi: इसने तपस्या द्वारा ब्रह्मा को प्रसन्न कर अख पाए हैं और उससे शपळे बेरियों को परास्त किद्मा है

verses.sloka: तौ शोणिताक्षयूपाक्षौ प्लवङ्गाभ्यां तरस्विनौ।चक्रुतुः समरे तीव्रमाकर्षोत्पाटनं भृशम् ।। ६.७६.३२ ।।
verses.transliteration: tau śoṇitākṣayūpākṣau plavaṅgābhyāṁ tarasvinau।cakrutuḥ samare tīvramākarṣotpāṭanaṁ bhṛśam ।। 6.76.32 ।।

translations.english: In that fight, courageous Sonitaksha and Yupaksha contested with the two monkeys pulling one another violently and throwing intensely.
translations.hindi: भ्रह्मा ने इसे सुरों ओर आसुर से अवध्य होने का बर दिआ है, अथात्‌ देवताओं ओर दैत्यां के हाथ से यह सर नहीं सकता इसे दिव्य कवच और सूये के समान चमक्रीला रथ भो (तप अभाव से } प्राप्त हुआ हे

verses.sloka: द्विविदः शोणिताक्षं तु विददार नखैर्मुखे।निष्पिपेष च वगेन क्षितावाविध्य वीर्यवान् ।। ६.७६.३३ ।।
verses.transliteration: dvividaḥ śoṇitākṣaṁ tu vidadāra nakhairmukhe।niṣpipeṣa ca vagena kṣitāvāvidhya vīryavān ।। 6.76.33 ।।

translations.english: Valiant Dwivida, for his part, tore Sonitaksha on his face with his nails, and quickening his pace threw him on the surface of the ground and bruised him.
translations.hindi: इसने सेकझे देवताओं और दानर्वो को पराजित कर गक्षसों को रक्षा की हे और यक्षो का संहार किआ है

verses.sloka: यूपाक्षमपि सङ्क्रुद्धो मैन्दो वानरयूथपः।पीडयामास बाहुभ्यां स पपात हतः क्षितौ ।। ६.७६.३४ ।।
verses.transliteration: yūpākṣamapi saṅkruddho maindo vānarayūthapaḥ।pīḍayāmāsa bāhubhyāṁ sa papāta hataḥ kṣitau ।। 6.76.34 ।।

translations.english: Vanara leader, Mainda on his part, angrily pierced Yupaksha many times who fell on the ground dead.
translations.hindi: इस रणकुशल् ने अपने बाणों से इनदर के बज की गति स्तम्भित कर दी थी तथा वरूण के पाश को व्यर्थ कर दिया था

verses.sloka: हतप्रवीरा व्यथिता राक्षसेन्द्रचमूस्तदा।जगामाभिमुखी सा तु कुम्भकर्णसुतो यतः ।। ६.७६.३५ ।।
verses.transliteration: hatapravīrā vyathitā rākṣasendracamūstadā।jagāmābhimukhī sā tu kumbhakarṇasuto yataḥ ।। 6.76.35 ।।

translations.english: Then many heroes died, Rakshasa king's army was distressed and went towards where Kumbhakarna's son was fighting.

verses.sloka: आपतन्तीं च वेगेन कुम्भस्तां सान्त्वयच्चमूम् ।। ६.७६.३६ ।।
verses.transliteration: āpatantīṁ ca vegena kumbhastāṁ sāntvayaccamūm ।। 6.76.36 ।।

translations.english: Kumbha quickly restored the confidence of the troops. Then energetic Kumbha seeing the eminent heroes of Rakshasa army struck down, he found a favourable opportunity and drew up an excellent strategy and performed an extremely difficult deed in the battlefield.
translations.hindi: हे पुरुषश्रेष्ठ ! सो उसके रोकने का कोई उपाय शीघ्र करना चाहिए । क्योकि यह सब से पहिले, मारे बाणा के वानरों ही का संहार कर रहा हे

verses.sloka: अथोत्कृष्टं महावीर्यैर्लब्धलक्षैः प्लवङ्गमैः।निपातितमहावीरां दृष्ट्वा रक्षश्चमूं ततः।कुम्भः प्रचक्रे तेजस्वी रणे कर्म सुदुष्करम् ।। ६.७६.३७ ।।
verses.transliteration: athotkṛṣṭaṁ mahāvīryairlabdhalakṣaiḥ plavaṅgamaiḥ।nipātitamahāvīrāṁ dṛṣṭvā rakṣaścamūṁ tataḥ।kumbhaḥ pracakre tejasvī raṇe karma suduṣkaram ।। 6.76.37 ।।

translations.english: Kumbha quickly restored the confidence of the troops. Then energetic Kumbha seeing the eminent heroes of Rakshasa army struck down, he found a favourable opportunity and drew up an excellent strategy and performed an extremely difficult deed in the battlefield.
translations.hindi: ततोऽतिकायो बलवान्‌ प्रविश्य हरिवाहिनीम्‌ । & ु विस्फारयामास धनुनंनाद च पुनः पुनः ॥३७)। तद्नन्तर बलवान्‌ अतिकाय वानरी सेना में घुस, घबुष को टंकारता हुआ, बारंबार सिंहनाद करने लगा

verses.sloka: स धनुर्धन्विनां श्रेष्ठः प्रगृह्य सुसमाहितः।मुमोचाशीविषप्रख्यान् शरान् देहविदारणान् ।। ६.७६.३८ ।।
verses.transliteration: sa dhanurdhanvināṁ śreṣṭhaḥ pragṛhya susamāhitaḥ।mumocāśīviṣaprakhyān śarān dehavidāraṇān ।। 6.76.38 ।।

translations.english: He (Kumbha), the foremost wielder of bow, taking up the bow, remaining fully composed released arrows that resembled poisonous serpents capable of tearing the flesh.

verses.sloka: तस्य तच्छुशुभे भूयः सशरं धनुरुत्तमम्।विद्युदैरावतार्चिष्माद्द्वितीयेन्द्रधनुर्यथा ।। ६.७६.३९ ।।
verses.transliteration: tasya tacchuśubhe bhūyaḥ saśaraṁ dhanuruttamam।vidyudairāvatārciṣmāddvitīyendradhanuryathā ।। 6.76.39 ।।

translations.english: Those best arrows fixed to the bow were shining like the cloud with flashes of lightning, and like a second bow of Indra.

verses.sloka: आकर्णाकृष्टमुक्तेन जघान द्विविदं तदा।तेन हाटकपुङ्खेन पत्रिणा पत्रवाससा ।। ६.७६.४० ।।
verses.transliteration: ākarṇākṛṣṭamuktena jaghāna dvividaṁ tadā।tena hāṭakapuṅkhena patriṇā patravāsasā ।। 6.76.40 ।।

translations.english: Then he struck Dwivida with a golden shafted arrow that was loosened to kill by stretching the bow till the ear and released.
translations.hindi: अखविद्या में निपुण महातेजभ्वी अतिकाय ने सुवर्शभूषित बाशों से उन वानर यूअपतियों के फेके हुए उन पेड़ों ओर पर्वेतों के ठुकड़े टुकड़े कर डाले

verses.sloka: सहसा ऽभिहतस्तेन विप्रमुक्तपदः स्फुरन्।निपपाताद्रिकूटाभो विह्वलः प्लवगोत्तमः ।। ६.७६.४१ ।।
verses.transliteration: sahasā 'bhihatastena vipramuktapadaḥ sphuran।nipapātādrikūṭābho vihvalaḥ plavagottamaḥ ।। 6.76.41 ।।

translations.english: Struck all of a sudden, the foremost Vanara (Dwivida) alarmed, fell with legs, outstretched, trembling.
translations.hindi: तदनन्तर उस भीमकाय वल्ली राइस ने अपने उपर आक्रसर करने बालं उन समस्त वानरयूथपतियों से युद्ध करते. हुए, .डनको लोहे के बाणों से घायल कर डाला

verses.sloka: मैन्दस्तु भ्रातरं दृष्ट्वा भग्नं तत्र महाहवे।अभिदुद्राव वेगेन प्रगृह्य महतीं शिलाम् ।। ६.७६.४२ ।।
verses.transliteration: maindastu bhrātaraṁ dṛṣṭvā bhagnaṁ tatra mahāhave।abhidudrāva vegena pragṛhya mahatīṁ śilām ।। 6.76.42 ।।

translations.english: Seeing the brother shattered in the great combat, Mainda on his part seizing a huge rock rushed swiftly.
translations.hindi: अतिकाय की बाणवषों से उन वानरों के शरीर क्षतविक्षत हो गए ओर वे पीडित हुए । वे उस महायुद्ध में अतिकाय को न रोक सके

verses.sloka: तां शिलां तु प्रचिक्षेप राक्षसाय महाबलः।बिभेद तां शिलां कुम्भः प्रसन्नैः पञ्चभिः शरैः ।। ६.७६.४३ ।।
verses.transliteration: tāṁ śilāṁ tu pracikṣepa rākṣasāya mahābalaḥ।bibheda tāṁ śilāṁ kumbhaḥ prasannaiḥ pañcabhiḥ śaraiḥ ।। 6.76.43 ।।

translations.english: The mighty Vanara (Mainda) for his part hurled the rock to crush the Rakshasa. Kumbha attacked him with five sharp arrows and rock got broken.

verses.sloka: सन्धाय चान्यं सुमुखं शरमासीविषोपमम्।आजघान महातेजा वक्षसि द्विविदाग्रजम् ।। ६.७६.४४ ।।
verses.transliteration: sandhāya cānyaṁ sumukhaṁ śaramāsīviṣopamam।ājaghāna mahātejā vakṣasi dvividāgrajam ।। 6.76.44 ।।

translations.english: Haughty Kumbha, fixed a charming arrow resembling a venomous serpent and struck at Dwivida's brother.
translations.hindi: उस राचसेर्द्र अतिकाय ने वानरी सेना में से ऐसे एक भी बंदर को ने मारा, जो उसके साथ लड़ने नहीं गया। बीरवर अतिकाय तरकस बाँचे और धनुष लिए हुए श्रीरामचन्द्र जा के खासने जा, उनसे गवं सहित घह बोल्या

verses.sloka: स तु तेन प्रहारेण मैन्दो वानरयूथपः।मर्मण्यभिहतस्तेन पपात भुवि मूर्च्छितः ।। ६.७६.४५ ।।
verses.transliteration: sa tu tena prahāreṇa maindo vānarayūthapaḥ।marmaṇyabhihatastena papāta bhuvi mūrcchitaḥ ।। 6.76.45 ।।

translations.english: That blow hit the Vanara leader in his private parts, and Mainda lost consciousness and fell down.
translations.hindi: देखो, मैं रथ पर सवार हूँ और मैरे हाथ में घनुष आलाय हैं । मे किसी साधारण योद्धा से लड़ना नहीं चाहता | याद क झै मेरे साथ लड्ने का साहस हो तो, वह शीघ्र आकर सुक लडे

verses.sloka: अङ्गदो मातुलौ दृष्ट्वा पतितौ तु महाबलौ।अभिदुद्राव वेगेन कुम्भमद्युतकार्मुकम् ।। ६.७६.४६ ।।
verses.transliteration: aṅgado mātulau dṛṣṭvā patitau tu mahābalau।abhidudrāva vegena kumbhamadyutakārmukam ।। 6.76.46 ।।

translations.english: Seeing the two maternal uncles fallen, Angada, who was endowed with great strength, attacked Kumbha, wielding a bow.
translations.hindi: राक्षस ऑतकाय की इस गर्दोक्ति को सुन, शवुहन्वा सद्म जी से न रहा गया | वह सुखकाते हुए, किन्तु क्रोध में भरे, धनुष _बाणहाथ में ले, उठ खर्डे हुए॥४३ पमा में ले, उठ खड हुए

verses.sloka: तमापतन्तं विव्याध कुम्भः पञ्चभिरायसैः।त्रिभिश्चान्यैः शितैर्बाणैर्मातङ्गमिव तोमरैः ।। ६.७६.४७ ।।
verses.transliteration: tamāpatantaṁ vivyādha kumbhaḥ pañcabhirāyasaiḥ।tribhiścānyaiḥ śitairbāṇairmātaṅgamiva tomaraiḥ ।। 6.76.47 ।।

translations.english: Kumbha seeing Angada advancing towards him, with five steel arrows and three shafts pierced him just as an elephant is pierced with lances.
translations.hindi: क्रोध में भरे लक्ष्मण जी ने खड़े होते हो तरकस से बाण खींच लिया और अतिकाय के सामने हो अपने बिशालधनुष शो टंकोरा

verses.sloka: सो ऽङ्गदं विविधैर्बाणैः कुम्भो विव्याध वीर्यवान्।अकुण्ठधारैर्निशितैस्तीक्ष्णैः कनकभूषणैः ।। ६.७६.४८ ।।
verses.transliteration: so 'ṅgadaṁ vividhairbāṇaiḥ kumbho vivyādha vīryavān।akuṇṭhadhārairniśitaistīkṣṇaiḥ kanakabhūṣaṇaiḥ ।। 6.76.48 ।।

translations.english: Kumbha, a valiant hero pierced Angada continuously with several sharp and pointed arrows decked with gold.
translations.hindi: टिप्पणा--जैसै पहलवान लोग कुश्ती लड़ते समय ताल ठोक कर अपने प्रतिद्वन्द्वी को उत्तेजित करते हैं, वैसे हो धनुर्धारियों के युद्ध में, घनुर्घारो बीर शत्र को उत्तेजित कर धनुष की श्रत्यंचा को खींच कर उसे खाली छोड़ देते थे । ऐसा करने से उसमें से शब्द होता था) छछीको टंकोर या टंकार कहते हैं | ] पूरयन्‌ स महीं सैलानाकाशं सागर दिश! । ज्याशब्दों ल&ष्मणस्योग्र्रासयन रजनीचरान

verses.sloka: अङ्गदः प्रतिविद्धाङ्गो वालिपुत्रो न कम्पते।शिलापादपवर्षाणि तस्य मूर्ध्नि ववर्ष ह ।। ६.७६.४९ ।।
verses.transliteration: aṅgadaḥ pratividdhāṅgo vāliputro na kampate।śilāpādapavarṣāṇi tasya mūrdhni vavarṣa ha ।। 6.76.49 ।।

translations.english: Vali's son was not shaken by the strike, showered rain of rocks and trees on his (Kumbha) forehead.

verses.sloka: स प्रचिच्छेद तान् सर्वान् बिभेद च पुनः शिलाः।कुम्भकर्णात्मजः श्रीमान् वालिपुत्रसमीरितान् ।। ६.७६.५० ।।
verses.transliteration: sa praciccheda tān sarvān bibheda ca punaḥ śilāḥ।kumbhakarṇātmajaḥ śrīmān vāliputrasamīritān ।। 6.76.50 ।।

translations.english: Prosperous Kumbhakarna's son also shattered the rocks hurled on him, breaking them.
translations.hindi: अतिकाय ने लक्स जो को युद्ध करने को खड होते ऐेख र क्रुद्ध हो, पैने बाण (तरकस से) निकाल, (लक्ष्मण जो से) _कहा

verses.sloka: आपतन्तं च सम्प्रेक्ष्य कुम्भो वानरयूथपम्।भ्रुवोर्विव्याध बाणाभ्यामुल्काभ्यामिव कुञ्जरम्।तस्य सुस्राव रुधिरं पिहिते चास्य लोचने ।। ६.७६.५१ ।।
verses.transliteration: āpatantaṁ ca samprekṣya kumbho vānarayūthapam।bhruvorvivyādha bāṇābhyāmulkābhyāmiva kuñjaram।tasya susrāva rudhiraṁ pihite cāsya locane ।। 6.76.51 ।।

translations.english: Kumbha observing the Vanara leader coming towards him attacked him with fire sticks and pierced his eyebrows.
translations.hindi: हे सौमित्र ! तू अभी बालक है। तू युद्धबिद्या में निपुण नहीं है । झुझ काल सदृश के साथ तू क्यों लड़ना चाहता है !

verses.sloka: अङ्गदः पाणिना नेत्रे पिधाय रुधिरोक्षिते।सालमासन्नमेकेन परिजग्राह पाणिना ।। ६.७६.५२ ।।्।सम्पीड्य चोरसि स्कन्धं करेणाभिनिवेश्य च।किञ्चिदभ्यवनम्यैनमुन्ममाथ यथा गजः ।। ६.७६.५३ ।।।
verses.transliteration: aṅgadaḥ pāṇinā netre pidhāya rudhirokṣite।sālamāsannamekena parijagrāha pāṇinā ।। 6.76.52 ।।्।sampīḍya corasi skandhaṁ kareṇābhiniveśya ca।kiñcidabhyavanamyainamunmamātha yathā gajaḥ ।। 6.76.53 ।।।

translations.english: Blood flowed from his injured eyes and his eyes got veiled by blood. Covering his eyes with one hand he took hold of a Sal tree nearby.
translations.hindi: ल्हु मेरे छोडे हुए बाणों के वेग को हिमालय पवत, आकाश र प्रथिवी--कोई भी नहीं सह सकता

verses.sloka: तमिन्द्रकेतुप्रतिमं वृक्षं मन्दरसन्निभम्।समुत्सृजन्तं वेगेन पश्यतां सर्वरक्षसाम् ।। ६.७६.५४ ।।
verses.transliteration: tamindraketupratimaṁ vṛkṣaṁ mandarasannibham।samutsṛjantaṁ vegena paśyatāṁ sarvarakṣasām ।। 6.76.54 ।।

translations.english: Compressing the trunk of the tree on the chest with one hand and bending forward a little its branches with another hand, he (Angada) tore Kumbha in that way in the great fight like an elephant.
translations.hindi: सो तू सुख से सोई हुई प्रलयकालीन आग को क्यों भड़काता है ? धनुष त्वाग कर लौट जा, मुझसे भिड़ कर अपमे प्राण मत खो

verses.sloka: स बिभेद शितैर्बाणैः सप्तभिः कायभेदनैः ।। ६.७६.५५ ।।
verses.transliteration: sa bibheda śitairbāṇaiḥ saptabhiḥ kāyabhedanaiḥ ।। 6.76.55 ।।

translations.english: All the Rakshasas seeing the tall tree, which was like Mandara mountain, resembling Indra's banner hurriedly was about to let loose.

verses.sloka: अङ्गदो विव्यथे ऽभीक्ष्णं ससाद च मुमोह च ।। ६.७६.५६ ।।
verses.transliteration: aṅgado vivyathe 'bhīkṣṇaṁ sasāda ca mumoha ca ।। 6.76.56 ।।

translations.english: Kumbha shattered Angada with seven sharp arrows capable of tearing the body. Angada, pained by that screamed and lost his senses.
translations.hindi: प्रति्टब्धः-- प्रतिमुखं स्थितः (गो०) २ ईश्वरायुधं-त्रिशूल | (गो०) ren ७५८ युष््काणछे सेरे इन शत्रुहन्ता ओर शत्र-इरप-इलन-कारी पेने बाण को देख ले, जो शिव जी के त्रिशूल के समान भयङ्कर हैं ओर सुबर्ण से भूषित हैं

verses.sloka: अङ्गदं व्यथितं दृष्ट्वा सीदन्तमिव सागरे।दुरासदं हरिश्रेष्ठं रामायन्ये न्यवेदयन् ।। ६.७६.५७ ।।
verses.transliteration: aṅgadaṁ vyathitaṁ dṛṣṭvā sīdantamiva sāgare।durāsadaṁ hariśreṣṭhaṁ rāmāyanye nyavedayan ।। 6.76.57 ।।

translations.english: Seeing the foremost Vanara, Angada who was difficult to encounter fell and like sinking into the ocean of despondency, the foremost Vanaras submitted to Rama.
translations.hindi: मेरा यह साँप के समान बाण तेरा रक्त उसी प्रकार पावेगा, जिस प्रकार क्रद सिंह, गज्नेन्द्र का रक्त पीता है | यह कह कर, उसने वह बाण अपने धह्लुष पर रखा

verses.sloka: रामस्तु व्यथितं श्रुत्वा वालिपुत्रं रणाजिरे।व्यादिदेश हरिश्रेष्ठान् जाम्बवत्प्रमुखांस्ततः ।। ६.७६.५८ ।।
verses.transliteration: rāmastu vyathitaṁ śrutvā vāliputraṁ raṇājire।vyādideśa hariśreṣṭhān jāmbavatpramukhāṁstataḥ ।। 6.76.58 ।।

translations.english: On hearing that Angada was tormented in the battlefield and pained he ordered Jambavan and the best of monkey leaders to help him.

verses.sloka: ते तु वानरशार्दूलाः श्रुत्वा रामस्य शासनम्।अभिपेतुः सुसङ्क्रुद्धाः कुम्भमुद्यतकार्मुकम् ।। ६.७६.५९ ।।
verses.transliteration: te tu vānaraśārdūlāḥ śrutvā rāmasya śāsanam।abhipetuḥ susaṅkruddhāḥ kumbhamudyatakārmukam ।। 6.76.59 ।।

translations.english: On hearing Rama's command, the enraged Vanara tigers took up bows to attack Kumbha.

verses.sloka: ततो द्रुमशिलाहस्ताः कोपसंरक्तलोचनाः।रिरक्षिषन्तो ऽभ्यपतन्नङ्गदं वानरर्षभाः ।। ६.७६.६० ।।
verses.transliteration: tato drumaśilāhastāḥ kopasaṁraktalocanāḥ।rirakṣiṣanto 'bhyapatannaṅgadaṁ vānararṣabhāḥ ।। 6.76.60 ।।

translations.english: Bulls among Vanaras then took trees, and rocks in hand, with their eyes red in anger started for the protection of Angada.

verses.sloka: जाम्बवांश्च सुषेणश्च वेगदर्शी च वानरः।कुम्भकर्णात्मजं वीरं क्रुद्धाः समभिदुद्रुवुः ।। ६.७६.६१ ।।
verses.transliteration: jāmbavāṁśca suṣeṇaśca vegadarśī ca vānaraḥ।kumbhakarṇātmajaṁ vīraṁ kruddhāḥ samabhidudruvuḥ ।। 6.76.61 ।।

translations.english: Jambavan, Sushena, Vegadarsi and other heroic Vanaras, full of anger also rushed to assail Kumbhakarna's son.
translations.hindi: तेरे पास सब प्रकार फे आयुध हैं, सू थब्नुघेर भी है ओर रथ पर सवार हे | सो चाहे धनुष बाश से अथवा अन्य किसी आयुध से (जिसमें तू दक्ष हो) अपना बल पराक्रम दिखला

verses.sloka: समीक्ष्यापततस्तांस्तु वानरेन्द्रान् महाबलान्।आववार शरौघेण नगेनेव जलाशयम् ।। ६.७६.६२ ।।
verses.transliteration: samīkṣyāpatatastāṁstu vānarendrān mahābalān।āvavāra śaraugheṇa nageneva jalāśayam ।। 6.76.62 ।।

translations.english: Perceiving that great army of Vanara leaders are advancing, Kumbha obstructed them with a volley of arrows just like a mountain obstructing the path of torrent.
translations.hindi: पीछे से तो में अपने पैसे बाणों से ब्रेरा सिर काट कर वैसे ही गिराऊँगा ही, जैसे हवा पके हुए ताल फल को गुच्छे से गिराती है

verses.sloka: तस्य बाणपथं प्राप्य न शोकुरतिवर्तितुम्।वानरेन्द्रा महात्मानो वेलामिव महोदधिः ।। ६.७६.६३ ।।
verses.transliteration: tasya bāṇapathaṁ prāpya na śokurativartitum।vānarendrā mahātmāno velāmiva mahodadhiḥ ।। 6.76.63 ।।

translations.english: The Vanara leaders could not bear the range of arrows of Kumbhaka, just as a tide can't overstep the shore of an ocean.
translations.hindi: ऐषीक को नष्ट हुआ देख, अतिकाय रोष भें भर गया और इससे एक वाण निकाल, उसे यमाख के मंत्र से अभिमंत्रित किआ

verses.sloka: तांस्तु दृष्ट्वा हरिगणान् शरवृष्टिबिरर्दितान्।अङ्गदं पृष्ठतः कृत्वा भ्रातृजं प्लवगेश्वरः ।। ६.७६.६४ ।।
verses.transliteration: tāṁstu dṛṣṭvā harigaṇān śaravṛṣṭibirarditān।aṅgadaṁ pṛṣṭhataḥ kṛtvā bhrātṛjaṁ plavageśvaraḥ ।। 6.76.64 ।।

translations.english: Seeing the Vanara army pained by the rain of arrows, Sugriva, the Lord of Vanaras having Angada in his rear, swiftly rushed and assailed Kumbhakarna's son just like a lion roaming in the mountains attacks elephants.

verses.sloka: अबिदुद्राव वेगेन सुग्रीवः कुम्भमाहवे।शैलसानुचरं नागं वेगवानिव केसरी ।। ६.७६.६५ ।।
verses.transliteration: abidudrāva vegena sugrīvaḥ kumbhamāhave।śailasānucaraṁ nāgaṁ vegavāniva kesarī ।। 6.76.65 ।।

translations.english: Seeing the Vanara army pained by the rain of arrows, Sugriva, the Lord of Vanaras having Angada in his rear, swiftly rushed and assailed Kumbhakarna's son just like a lion roaming in the mountains attacks elephants.

verses.sloka: उत्पाट्य च महाशैलानश्वकर्णान् धवान् बहून्।अन्यांश्च विविधान् वृक्षांश्चिक्षेप च महाबलः ।। ६.७६.६६ ।।
verses.transliteration: utpāṭya ca mahāśailānaśvakarṇān dhavān bahūn।anyāṁśca vividhān vṛkṣāṁścikṣepa ca mahābalaḥ ।। 6.76.66 ।।

translations.english: Mighty strong he was, uprooting Aswakarna and many other several kinds of trees he hurled at them (Rakshasas).
translations.hindi: देख, विष्णु, बालक ही थे, जिन्होंने तीन पैर से तीनों लोक नाप डाले थे। यह कह क्रोध सें भर लक्ष्मस जी ने कुपित हो आपने धनुष पर बाण रखे

verses.sloka: तां छादयन्तीमाकाशं वृक्षवृष्टिं दुरासदाम्।कुम्भकर्णात्मजः शीघ्रं चिच्छेद निशितैः शरैः ।। ६.७६.६७ ।।
verses.transliteration: tāṁ chādayantīmākāśaṁ vṛkṣavṛṣṭiṁ durāsadām।kumbhakarṇātmajaḥ śīghraṁ ciccheda niśitaiḥ śaraiḥ ।। 6.76.67 ।।

translations.english: Frenzied Kumbhakarna's son was torn under the shower of trees that covered space with sharp arrows which was difficult to approach.
translations.hindi: उधर लक्ष्मण जी के युक्तियुक्त ओर अर्श अतिकाय सारे क्रोध के आगबबूला हो गय बाण निकाला ।'६५॥ 'ततो विद्याधरा भूता देवा दैत्या महषयः । , युद्यकाऱच महात्मानस्तच द्वं इष्टुमागमन

verses.sloka: अभिलक्षेण तीव्रेण कुम्भेन निशितैः शरैः।आचितास्ते द्रुमा रेजुर्यथा घोराः शतघ्नयः ।। ६.७६.६८ ।।
verses.transliteration: abhilakṣeṇa tīvreṇa kumbhena niśitaiḥ śaraiḥ।ācitāste drumā rejuryathā ghorāḥ śataghnayaḥ ।। 6.76.68 ।।

translations.english: The sharp arrows aimed at the target by Kumbha covered the trees and they shone like dreadful Sataghnis.

verses.sloka: द्रुमवर्षं तु तच्छिन्नं दृष्ट्वा कुम्भेन वीर्यवान्।वानराधिपतिः श्रीमान् महासत्त्वो न विव्यथे ।। ६.७६.६९ ।।
verses.transliteration: drumavarṣaṁ tu tacchinnaṁ dṛṣṭvā kumbhena vīryavān।vānarādhipatiḥ śrīmān mahāsattvo na vivyathe ।। 6.76.69 ।।

translations.english: Valiant hero, the prosperous and noble Sugriva, the chief of Vanaras did not get distressed when tormented with rain of trees.

verses.sloka: निर्भिद्यमानः सहसा सहमानश्च तान् शरान्।कुम्भस्य धनुराक्षिप्य बभञ्जेन्द्रधनुष्प्रभम् ।। ६.७६.७० ।।
verses.transliteration: nirbhidyamānaḥ sahasā sahamānaśca tān śarān।kumbhasya dhanurākṣipya babhañjendradhanuṣprabham ।। 6.76.70 ।।

translations.english: He snatched the bow of Kumbha forcibly which was like Indra's rainbow, pulled it and broke, while tolerating the pain of the arrows.

verses.sloka: अवप्लुत्य ततः शीघ्रं कृत्वा कर्म सुदुष्करम्।अब्रवीत् कुपितः कुम्भं भग्नशृङ्गमिव द्विपम् ।। ६.७६.७१ ।।
verses.transliteration: avaplutya tataḥ śīghraṁ kṛtvā karma suduṣkaram।abravīt kupitaḥ kumbhaṁ bhagnaśṛṅgamiva dvipam ।। 6.76.71 ।।

translations.english: Then Sugriva leapt into the chariot, which was a difficult deed to perform, saw Kumbha who was like an elephant and whose tusks were broken and spoke.

verses.sloka: निकुम्भाग्रज वीर्यं ते बाणवेगवदद्भुतम्।सन्नतिश्च प्रभावश्च तव वा रावणस्य वा ।। ६.७६.७२ ।।
verses.transliteration: nikumbhāgraja vīryaṁ te bāṇavegavadadbhutam।sannatiśca prabhāvaśca tava vā rāvaṇasya vā ।। 6.76.72 ।।

translations.english: "Oh, elder brother of Nikumbha! Your valour, speed of your arrows, compliance, and glory is wonderful like that of Ravana's."

verses.sloka: प्रह्लादबलिवृत्रघ्नकुबेवरुणोपम।एकस्त्वमनुजातो ऽसि पितरं बलवृत्ततः ।। ६.७६.७३ ।।
verses.transliteration: prahlādabalivṛtraghnakubevaruṇopama।ekastvamanujāto 'si pitaraṁ balavṛttataḥ ।। 6.76.73 ।।

translations.english: "You are equal to Prahlada, Bali, Indra, Kubera and Varuna in might. You alone have taken over like your father."

verses.sloka: त्वामेवैकं महाबाहुं चापहस्त मरिन्दमम्।त्रिदशा नातिवर्तन्ते जितेन्द्रियमिवाधयः ।। ६.७६.७४ ।।
verses.transliteration: tvāmevaikaṁ mahābāhuṁ cāpahasta marindamam।tridaśā nātivartante jitendriyamivādhayaḥ ।। 6.76.74 ।।

translations.english: "Oh! mightyarmed, Kumbha! wielding pike in hand, you are a tamer of enemies, you alone are the one that gods are not able to overcome, a pre eminent one who has gained over senses, highly intelligent, exhibiting your prowess and deeds before me."
translations.hindi: वानर वीरों की उस सेना को उस राक्षस ने त्रस्त कर डाला | वह जवानी के मद में चूर राक्षस, कुद्ध हो बानरों को वैसे ही डराने लगा, जैसे सिह सर्गो के मुरुड को डराता है'

verses.sloka: विक्रमस्व महाबुद्धे कर्माणि मम पश्यतः ।। ६.७६.७५ ।।
verses.transliteration: vikramasva mahābuddhe karmāṇi mama paśyataḥ ।। 6.76.75 ।।

translations.english: "Oh! mightyarmed, Kumbha! wielding pike in hand, you are a tamer of enemies, you alone are the one that gods are not able to overcome, a pre eminent one who has gained over senses, highly intelligent, exhibiting your prowess and deeds before me."
translations.hindi: दह बाण उस भीमपराक्रमो राक्षस के मस्तक भें घुस गया । उस समय बह बाण ऐसा जान पड़ा, सानों रुधिर में सना साँप परेत सें शुस्ता हो

verses.sloka: वरदानात् पितृव्यस्ते सहते देवदानवान्।कुम्भकर्णस्तु वीर्येण सहते च सुरासुरान् ।। ६.७६.७६ ।।
verses.transliteration: varadānāt pitṛvyaste sahate devadānavān।kumbhakarṇastu vīryeṇa sahate ca surāsurān ।। 6.76.76 ।।

translations.english: "Your uncle Ravana is able to withstand the Devas and Danavas by virtue of the boons and Kumbhakarna was able to with stand gods and demons by virtue of his courage."

verses.sloka: धनुषीन्द्रजितस्तुल्यः प्रतापे रावणस्य च।त्वमद्य रक्षसां लोके श्रेष्ठो ऽसि बलवीर्यतः ।। ६.७६.७७ ।।
verses.transliteration: dhanuṣīndrajitastulyaḥ pratāpe rāvaṇasya ca।tvamadya rakṣasāṁ loke śreṣṭho 'si balavīryataḥ ।। 6.76.77 ।।

translations.english: Thereafter Kumbha held Sugriva's shoulders. They were like two intoxicated elephants holding one another's limbs and rubbing each other and breathing heavily. In exertion they let out from their face fire mixed with smoke.

verses.sloka: महाविमर्दं समरे मया सह तवाद्भुतम्।अद्य भूतानि पश्यन्तु शक्रशम्बरयोरिव ।। ६.७६.७८ ।।
verses.transliteration: mahāvimardaṁ samare mayā saha tavādbhutam।adya bhūtāni paśyantu śakraśambarayoriva ।। 6.76.78 ।।

translations.english: "Just as the wonderful conflict between Indra and Sambara let the beings witness the mighty comb at between me and you."
translations.hindi: Co न्तर सह।बलब्रान्‌ अतिकाय क्ण भर में सावधान हो सन ही सन कुछ सोच कर ओर आगे का आपता कत्तव्य निश्चित कर योला-शा दाश ! बार मारे तो ऐसा | लक्ष्मण । तू मेरा शत्र होने पर्‌ था सराहून यगय है (७६!) 2 ३. स रथापस्यसास्थाद रथन परवचा || ७9 च लदसण जा का इस प्रकार प्रशसा कर आर सुदु बाय तथा! सुजाश्रां को झुका कर, अपने रथ पर खवार बहू समरसूपि घूमन लना

verses.sloka: कृतमप्रतिमं कर्म दर्शितं चास्त्रकौशलम्।पातिता हरिवीराश्च त्वया वै भीमविक्रमाः ।। ६.७६.७९ ।।
verses.transliteration: kṛtamapratimaṁ karma darśitaṁ cāstrakauśalam।pātitā harivīrāśca tvayā vai bhīmavikramāḥ ।। 6.76.79 ।।

translations.english: "By an unequal deed done by you in the efficiency in the use of weapons has been exhibited. The monkey heroes of terrific valour have been made to fall."

verses.sloka: उपालम्भभयाच्चापि नासि वीर मया हतः।कृतकर्मा परिश्रान्तो विश्रान्तः पश्य मे बलम् ।। ६.७६.८० ।।
verses.transliteration: upālambhabhayāccāpi nāsi vīra mayā hataḥ।kṛtakarmā pariśrānto viśrāntaḥ paśya me balam ।। 6.76.80 ।।

translations.english: "O Stalwart! You have not been finished by me for the fear of reproaching. You are exhausted by your deeds and resting. Having rested, witness my strength now."
translations.hindi: युद्धकाण्डे अत्रुघाती लक्ष्ण ने अपने पैने बाणों से डन समस्त बाणं को नै पिता त्री तरह चमचसाता इस काट कर, एक अत्यन्त पलां आर अमर का तरह चमचसाता हुआ बाण निकाला

verses.sloka: तेन सुग्रीववाक्येन सावमानेन मानितः।अग्नेराज्याहुतस्येव तेजस्तस्याभ्यवर्धत।ततः कुम्भस्तु सुग्रीवं बाहुभ्यां जगृहे तदा ।। ६.७६.८१ ।।
verses.transliteration: tena sugrīvavākyena sāvamānena mānitaḥ।agnerājyāhutasyeva tejastasyābhyavardhata।tataḥ kumbhastu sugrīvaṁ bāhubhyāṁ jagṛhe tadā ।। 6.76.81 ।।

translations.english: Sugriva's words of flattering royalty captivated Kumbha's fire of energy, which doubled like fire fed with ghee.

verses.sloka: गजाविवाहितमदौ निश्वसन्तौ मुहुर्मुहुः।अन्योन्यगात्रग्रथितौ कर्षन्तावितरेतरम्।सधूमां मुखतो ज्वालां विसृजन्तौ परिश्रमात् ।। ६.७६.८२ ।।
verses.transliteration: gajāvivāhitamadau niśvasantau muhurmuhuḥ।anyonyagātragrathitau karṣantāvitaretaram।sadhūmāṁ mukhato jvālāṁ visṛjantau pariśramāt ।। 6.76.82 ।।

translations.english: Sugriva's words of flattering royalty captivated Kumbha's fire of energy, which doubled like fire fed with ghee.
translations.hindi: राबणुपुत्र अतिकाय ने अपने उन बाणों को युद्धभूमि में कटां हुआ देख, बड़ा क्रोध रिआ और उन इन्ट्रशत्र ने एक बड़ा पैना बाण निकाला

verses.sloka: तयोः पादाभिघाताच्च निमग्ना चाभवन्मही।व्याघूर्णिततरङ्गश्च चुक्षुभे वरुणालयः ।। ६.७६.८३ ।।
verses.transliteration: tayoḥ pādābhighātācca nimagnā cābhavanmahī।vyāghūrṇitataraṅgaśca cukṣubhe varuṇālayaḥ ।। 6.76.83 ।।

translations.english: Sugriva's words of flattering royalty captivated Kumbha's fire of energy, which doubled like fire fed with ghee.

verses.sloka: ततः कुम्भं समुत्क्षिप्य सुग्रीवो लवणाम्भसि।पातयामास वेगेन दर्शयन्नुदधेस्तलम् ।। ६.७६.८४ ।।
verses.transliteration: tataḥ kumbhaṁ samutkṣipya sugrīvo lavaṇāmbhasi।pātayāmāsa vegena darśayannudadhestalam ।। 6.76.84 ।।

translations.english: Then by the trampling of their feet the earth sank down, the abode of Varuna (ocean) was agitated with rolling waves.
translations.hindi: इस लड़ाई में अतिकाय के चलाए उस बाण के लक्ष्मण जी की छाती में लगते से, वैसे ही रक्त बहने लगा, जैसे सतवाले हाथी के मस्तक से मद बहता है

verses.sloka: ततः कुम्भनिपातेन जलराशिः समुत्थितः।विन्ध्यमन्दरसङ्काशो विससर्प समन्ततः ।। ६.७६.८५ ।।
verses.transliteration: tataḥ kumbhanipātena jalarāśiḥ samutthitaḥ।vindhyamandarasaṅkāśo visasarpa samantataḥ ।। 6.76.85 ।।

translations.english: Then Sugriva lifted Kumbha and threw him into the ocean quickly, to show him the bottom.

verses.sloka: ततः कुम्भः समुत्पत्य सुग्रीवमभिपत्य च।आजघानोरसि क्रुद्धो वज्रवेगेन मुष्टिना ।। ६.७६.८६ ।।
verses.transliteration: tataḥ kumbhaḥ samutpatya sugrīvamabhipatya ca।ājaghānorasi kruddho vajravegena muṣṭinā ।। 6.76.86 ।।

translations.english: By Kumbha falling into the ocean, it got swollen to the form of Vindhya and Mandara mountain and water flowed all over.

verses.sloka: तस्य चर्म च पुस्फोट बहु सुस्राव शोणितम्।स च मुष्टिर्महावेगः प्रतिजघ्ने ऽस्थिमण्डले ।। ६.७६.८७ ।।
verses.transliteration: tasya carma ca pusphoṭa bahu susrāva śoṇitam।sa ca muṣṭirmahāvegaḥ pratijaghne 'sthimaṇḍale ।। 6.76.87 ।।

translations.english: Then Kumbha hit Sugriva in anger with his fist at the speed of a thunderbolt on his chest.
translations.hindi: आग्नेयाख को आते देख. श्रतिकाय ने सुवर्णपुङ्ख वाला सरकार बाण निकाल और उसे सौर्या के मंत्र से अभिमंत्रित कर छोड़ा

verses.sloka: तदा वेगेन तत्रासीत्तेजः प्रज्वलितं मुहुः।वज्रनिष्पेषसञ्जाता ज्वाला मेरौ यथा गिरौ ।। ६.७६.८८ ।।
verses.transliteration: tadā vegena tatrāsīttejaḥ prajvalitaṁ muhuḥ।vajraniṣpeṣasañjātā jvālā merau yathā girau ।। 6.76.88 ।।

translations.english: The armour of Sugriva slit open, and blood flowed at high speed and excessively. The first hit of Kumbha hit the skeletal framework of Sugriva in return.
translations.hindi: जिस प्रकार थमराज कालदण्ड को चलाते हूँ, उसी प्रकार लक्ष्मण जी ने दिव्यास्त्र के मंत्र से अभिमंत्रित कर, वह बाण अतिकाय पर चलाया

verses.sloka: स तत्राभिहतस्तेन सुग्रीवो वानरर्षभः।मुष्टिं संवर्तयामास वज्रकल्पं महाबलः ।। ६.७६.८९ ।।
verses.transliteration: sa tatrābhihatastena sugrīvo vānararṣabhaḥ।muṣṭiṁ saṁvartayāmāsa vajrakalpaṁ mahābalaḥ ।। 6.76.89 ।।

translations.english: Then by the speed of the hit on Sugriva's chest by Kumbha's fist a flame burst forth like the flame of Meru Mountain.
translations.hindi: आंग्नेयेनाभिसंयुक्त दृष्टा बाणं निशाचरः | © ७ ८. है . उत्ससज तदा बाण दीप सूयांख्यो जितम्‌

verses.sloka: अर्चिस्सहस्रविकचं रविमण्डलसप्रभम्।स मुष्टिं पातयामास कुम्भस्योरसि वीर्यवान् ।। ६.७६.९० ।।
verses.transliteration: arcissahasravikacaṁ ravimaṇḍalasaprabham।sa muṣṭiṁ pātayāmāsa kumbhasyorasi vīryavān ।। 6.76.90 ।।

translations.english: Then mighty Sugriva, the bull among Vanaras, hit by the fist, clenched his fist adamantly.

verses.sloka: स तु तेन प्रहारेण विह्वलो भृशताडितः।निपपात तदा कुम्भो गतार्चिरिव पावकः ।। ६.७६.९१ ।।
verses.transliteration: sa tu tena prahāreṇa vihvalo bhṛśatāḍitaḥ।nipapāta tadā kumbho gatārciriva pāvakaḥ ।। 6.76.91 ।।

translations.english: Sugriva, the champion pressed his first which shone like the Sun encircled with rays on the chest of Kumbha.

verses.sloka: मुष्टिना ऽभिहतस्तेन निपपाताशु राक्षसः।लोहिताङ्ग इवाकाशाद्दीप्तरश्मिर्यदृच्छया ।। ६.७६.९२ ।।
verses.transliteration: muṣṭinā 'bhihatastena nipapātāśu rākṣasaḥ।lohitāṅga ivākāśāddīptaraśmiryadṛcchayā ।। 6.76.92 ।।

translations.english: By the blow of Sugriva, that Kumbha was pained severely and overcome by fear he fell like fire which has lost its glow.

verses.sloka: कुम्भस्य पततो रूपं भग्नस्योरसि मुष्टिना।बभौ रुद्राभिपन्नस्य यथा रूपं गवां पतेः ।। ६.७६.९३ ।।
verses.transliteration: kumbhasya patato rūpaṁ bhagnasyorasi muṣṭinā।babhau rudrābhipannasya yathā rūpaṁ gavāṁ pateḥ ।। 6.76.93 ।।

translations.english: Struck by the fist of Sugriva, the Rakshasa fell just as the glowing planet endowed with brightness accidentally fell from the sky.

verses.sloka: तस्मिन् हते भीमपराक्रमेण प्लवङ्गमानामृषभेण युद्धे।मही सशैला सवना चचाल भयं च रक्षांस्यधिकं विवेश ।। ६.७६.९४ ।।
verses.transliteration: tasmin hate bhīmaparākrameṇa plavaṅgamānāmṛṣabheṇa yuddhe।mahī saśailā savanā cacāla bhayaṁ ca rakṣāṁsyadhikaṁ viveśa ।। 6.76.94 ।।

translations.english: Struck in the chest by Sugriva's fist, Kumbha fell down and shone like the Sun god over powered by Rudra।।

verses.sloka: इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमद्युद्धकाण्डे षट्सप्ततितमः सर्गः ।। ७६ ।।
verses.transliteration: ityārṣe śrīmadrāmāyaṇe vālmīkīye ādikāvye śrīmadyuddhakāṇḍe ṣaṭsaptatitamaḥ sargaḥ ।। 76 ।।

translations.english: When he of terrible prowess was slain in combat by that bull among monkeys, the earth with its mountains and forests trembled, and fear entered still deeper into the rakshasas.
